reason: A collection of DeepSeek Harness utility plugins for managing Skills and MCP servers, adding session and workspace controls, and modifying approval-related tool behavior; human review is warranted because two packages affect permission and sandbox dispatch behavior.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供技能与 MCP 管理、会话控制、工作区操作及审批相关工具调度增强功能。
summaries.en: A collection of DeepSeek Harness plugins for managing Skills and MCP servers, adding session and workspace controls, and enhancing approval-related tool dispatch behavior.

capabilities: Manage Harness Skills and MCP servers from a session
Provide Web settings pages for Skills and MCP servers
Add a workspace File Explorer action
Modify permission approval behavior and tool-dispatch sandbox arguments
